🥛 Get your milk order in—you won’t regret it! 🥛

Fresh, local milk from Rocking W Cheese is coming Friday! 🥛 

Choose from Whole, 2%, or Creamy Top milk.

To order:
• Send us a Facebook message with your name & phone number
• Or text Marcia at 970-424-8888

🗓️ Orders must be in by Thursday morning 
*Pickup at the farm store Friday afternoon through Sunday

📍 Smith Family Orchards Farm Store
680 36-1/4 Road, Palisade, CO

🍂 Fall Hours:
Thursday–Saturday: 10 AM–4 PM
Sunday: 10 AM–3 PM

Come grab your fresh milk and check out all the amazing local maker creations while you’re here!
